reviews.text: Thank you so much for these 5 stars!

They're really attentive, reassuring, take their time, and put you at ease. They love their work.
Everyone is incredibly friendly and caring.

I booked an initial appointment through the website, selecting "dermatological consultation."

Before booking, I tried to contact them by phone to confirm the reason for the consultation. I couldn't reach them.
This appointment was made at the request of my regular veterinarian, who lacked the expertise to treat my cat's recurring skin problem.
Once I arrived for the appointment, we created my cat's file. I received a warm welcome.
After my cat was taken out of the carrier and settled in the consultation room, the veterinarian informed me that she was not a dermatologist and that none of the staff present had this specialization.

She proceeded with the appointment nonetheless and made a diagnosis. This diagnosis differed from those I had received during other appointments with other veterinarians. She still advised me that if the problems persisted, I should see a dermatologist… I ended up paying for the veterinary consultation plus some products (€70) plus medication to pick up at the pharmacy (€30), hoping it would work.

To date, there's been no improvement, and I feel like I've wasted €100… I would have preferred they cancel the appointment or that the receptionist, when creating my file, had informed me that no dermatologist was available. Ultimately, I was presented with a fait accompli once I was seated in the consultation room.

Excellent clinic, highly recommended to everyone. I had a sick cat, and thanks to them, a true professional discovered what was wrong with her. They work very professionally, are very attentive, and very accommodating. They've gained two new clients; we've taken in a kitten, and she will be treated there. This clinic is legendary; you can trust them.
They are always perfect and attentive!
Ms. Macedo, thank you so much for your 5 stars! Hoping Ayron is feeling better. Have a wonderful day!
Thank you so much for these 5 stars, Madame Jacques! Give Caline a cuddle from the whole team 😄 …

Excellent vets!! They were very kind and took great care of my kitten during his spaying procedure, and even called me the next day to check on him.
My kitten had been seeing an incompetent vet until then, so I'm so glad I found this clinic!

My cat Flynn was a patient at this clinic for over 15 years. He has sadly passed away. But throughout his life, the care he received was perfect! A huge thank you to the team for taking such good care of him all these years!

Hello,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us.

Bagghera and I were always made to feel very welcome.
Thank you again for your excellent professional work and your kindness!

Friendly
Efficient
But TOO EXPENSIVE!

Disappointed.

I entrusted my dog ​​to this clinic for almost 10 years. Unfortunately, he recently passed away from cancer. In hindsight, I am very disappointed with the medical care he received. In 10 years, he was never offered a single blood test or check-up, which seems essential to me for detecting health problems, especially as he ages. A huge disappointment.

Hello,
Thank you for your positive review. It means a lot to us to know that you enjoyed your experience with us. We hope to see you again soon!
Ms. Collard, thank you so much for the 5 stars! Give Roxy a cuddle from the team 😊 …

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. They offer 24/7 service, and the "NETTER" clinic in the 12th arrondissement is particularly exceptional, from the initial welcome to the care and attention they give to both the animal and the owner. Thank you!

My cat was recently diagnosed with a serious illness during an emergency consultation at a clinic in Paris. His days are numbered. This clinic, which has been treating him for almost 10 years, hasn't really taken over his care since then. I had to insist on seeing a veterinarian the next day who could explain more precisely what to do in the coming days. So I'm following the palliative care instructions given during the emergency consultation... I had expected closer follow-up, but I suppose that would require paying for a dedicated consultation.
Excellent veterinary clinic

Extremely disappointing.

My cat was treated at this clinic for several years. Now, although we've moved to Lyon, we regularly return to Paris and thought we could continue to rely on this veterinarian.
My cat has cancer and a valid prescription for pain medication. Despite this, the clinic refused to dispense the medication, offering no alternative solution and leaving my cat without pain relief.
I find this situation appalling and deeply shocking. Refusing palliative treatment to a seriously ill animal is difficult to understand, both from a human and ethical standpoint.
Based on this experience, I unfortunately can no longer recommend this clinic.
The welcome, the care, the follow-up... everything has always been perfect for years that I've been bringing my cats here! Thank you
Excellent clinic: caring, professional, and attentive team. Our animals are always very well cared for there. I highly recommend it!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! 😊 …
As usual, the staff are very pleasant and attentive.

A huge thank you to the whole team; we were treated with great care. They explained the treatment plan for our dog perfectly. We've been fortunate enough to have this clinic as our preferred veterinarian for almost six years now.

I'm very happy to have found this veterinary clinic at 60 Avenue du Dr Arnold Netter - 75012 Paris. It was open Monday to Friday from 9 am to 7 pm and Saturday from 9 am to 12 pm. 😄 The phone call was quick, the receptionists are very friendly and welcoming, and what's more, their doctor, Dr. Irène Gomez, is a gentle woman who took the time to listen to me and treat my two cats professionally and gently.

Thank you, Dr. Irene, and thank you for the €16 discount on my two kittens 😁 and the samples of cat food 🫠, very kind 😊🙃 I also want to thank your secretaries 🫠 for this appointment, because without them I wouldn't have had the opportunity to meet you, Dr. Irene Gomez 🙃
All my respect to this clinic 🙂🫲🫲💌💖
An excellent veterinary clinic: the team is very professional, caring, attentive, and genuinely concerned about your pet's well-being. Thank you!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! 😊 …
Excellent care for the animals - Very good follow-up - Very humane interactions
The secretary and the vet were very nice too.

I came a few weeks ago with my dog ​​and cat.

I wanted to say a big thank you to the whole team for their wonderful welcome, and especially thank Eliott for his patience and expertise with my stubborn little dog.
Avoid at all costs!!!! If you love your animals

Hello Ms. Ionescu,
Thank you so much for the 5 stars!

We are delighted that you are satisfied.
Give Tuco a cuddle 😊

Hello Madam,
We haven't seen you since February 2024 and therefore don't understand this review. We would like to discuss this with you to understand the reasons and improve our service. Please feel free to contact us at 0143467430.
Have a good day.

Fantastic welcome! So much kindness and consideration towards both my cat Oliver and me. Dr. Irene GomezDiaz Pedreno is incredibly helpful and empathetic, even offering to help me get home when I couldn't find a rideshare or taxi. I was incredibly touched and very grateful. I will confidently entrust my cat Oliver to her for a dental cleaning under general anesthesia next August! 😊
A very professional and welcoming clinic. Scarlett receives excellent care there. She is over 15 years old and enjoying a peaceful retirement.
Absolutely lovely! I was very reassured by a charming lady last Wednesday regarding my cat Gaspard. 🌷 …
Excellent team, good and attentive service, very pleasant visit.
Absolutely fantastic! The lady at reception is just lovely, thank you for all her helpful advice.

I was extremely satisfied with this clinic, with the care Dr. Alcazar and his assistants gave our Honey Boy.

Our adorable little dog passed away while Dr. Alcazar was on vacation, and unfortunately, he wasn't able to intervene and help him cope with the situation.
That said, I highly recommend this clinic.
always attentive and offers excellent advice
Excellent experience for a first consultation with our 3-month-old kitten. We highly recommend!
They really helped me with the cat flea demonstration... thank you

My dog ​​was euthanized on Monday because he was paralyzed in his hind legs. I received excellent service. The vet knew Heliot because that's where he was treated. They were very calm and attentive. I highly recommend them.

Do you know why some people abandon their dogs?
Well, when I called your head vet, Dr. Lapaingard, about a slight delay (I wasn't far away), Dr. Lapaingard told her assistant I'd be 10 minutes late and that it wasn't worth my while to come and sort things out. It was pouring rain, and my Yorkie was soaked!
Remove people like you from your records. I don't need a reminder. Last year you didn't call me, and I found a vet near my home!

I had very fond memories of Loic, which is why I made the trip.

It allowed me to see that he too has changed drastically. Money, money, money is more important than anything else. It's a shame; I preferred you as you were, "YOU," if you know what I mean...

Hello Guillaume,
We are delighted to see your excellent feedback and wanted to thank you sincerely. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back very soon.
Picpus Veterinary Clinic Paris - Sevetys
Excellent team. Warm welcome. Very kind to my cat.

Thank you so much for these five stars, Ms. Ménard!

See you very soon ;-)
My dog's designated veterinarian

Excellent clinic, Mr. Alcazar and his entire team (assistants, veterinarians) are wonderful. Patient, knowledgeable, available, and with fair prices. I've been taking my two cats there for two years now, without hesitation. Thank you, I highly recommend them.
Excessively expensive compared to other clinics that are better and also in the same neighborhood

Hello,
We are delighted to see that you enjoyed your experience with our veterinary team! Thank you for taking the time to leave us a positive review.
Excellent veterinary clinic: warm welcome, excellent care 😍 …
Dr. Alcazar is great!!!! Very kind, he took the time to explain everything to us.
All the staff are incredibly attentive! I highly recommend this practice.

My cat died yesterday, October 16th. I contacted the veterinary clinic to find out what to do. They asked me to bring my cat in, which I did, accompanied by my mother and sister. All three of us were in tears, hoping for a little compassion, but the vet didn't even take the time to greet us. He simply took our cat without warning us that we wouldn't be able to say a final goodbye. After such a painful experience, I expected at least a modicum of empathy. I am therefore extremely disappointed and strongly advise against going to this heartless place.
Excellent veterinarians and I'm very satisfied. My little Pitti adores Dr. Lepaingard, which is very reassuring; Pitti is always happy to see her doctor. Thank you to them!

Fantastic practice, with incredibly caring vets! My two cats, Cosimo and Nanni, were initially seen by Dr. Willms, who is now at another Sevetys clinic in Paris, and are currently being seen by Dr. Alcazar. Impeccable care, gentle and …
I confirm my previous opinion. The welcome was very good, and Dr. Alcazar and his assistant were attentive and very gentle with my cats.
